name: komdosh-dev-infra-kubernetes
description: Kubernetes manifest authoring, security hardening, and workload troubleshooting. Ships three agents — k8s-manifest-author (hardened Deployments/StatefulSets, Kustomize overlays, Helm values, probes, PDB/HPA, graceful shutdown), the read-only k8s-hardening-auditor (Pod Security Standards restricted + resource discipline + reliability, classified BLOCKER/WARNING/INFO), and k8s-troubleshooter (root-cause diagnosis of CrashLoopBackOff / ImagePullBackOff / OOMKilled / Pending / probe failures) — two internal skills (discover-k8s-workloads inventory, probe-cluster-state live read-only kubectl probe), three rule documents (k8s-manifests, k8s-security, k8s-resources), and three commands: /k8s-manifest, /k8s-audit, /k8s-debug. Never mutates a cluster (no apply/delete/edit). Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.
